euclidean_distances.title: Euclidean
euclidean_distances.note: Optional w multiplies each squared coordinate difference.

sqeuclidean_distances.title: Squared Euclidean
sqeuclidean_distances.note: Returns squared units; useful for losses and Gaussian kernels. Optional feature weights w.

manhattan_distances.title: Manhattan
manhattan_distances.note: Also called L1 or cityblock. Optional feature weights w.

minkowski_distances.title: Minkowski
minkowski_distances.note: p defaults to 2. Positive finite p uses this formula; infinity selects the maximum and p=0 counts unequal coordinates. With weights, p must be positive; p<1 is not a metric.

wminkowski_distances.title: Weighted Minkowski
wminkowski_distances.note: Provide nonnegative w ending in [D]; p must be positive. Weights multiply the powered differences, rather than being raised to p.

chebyshev_distances.title: Chebyshev
chebyshev_distances.note: With w, only coordinates with positive weight participate; their weight magnitudes do not scale the maximum.

seuclidean_distances.title: Standardized Euclidean
seuclidean_distances.note: V is a positive feature-variance tensor ending in [D]. Self collection comparisons may infer it; paired/single and explicit cross collections require V.

mahalanobis_distances.title: Mahalanobis
mahalanobis_distances.note: VI ends in [D,D] and represents the inverse covariance. Paired/single and explicit cross collections require it; self collection comparisons may infer it.

cosine_distances.title: Cosine Distance
cosine_distances.note: Optional w gives weighted dot products and norms. Zero-norm cross comparisons return 1; identity self comparisons explicitly zero the diagonal.

correlation_distances.title: Correlation Distance
correlation_distances.formula: d(x,y)=1-\frac{\langle x-\bar x,y-\bar y\rangle}{\|x-\bar x\|_2\|y-\bar y\|_2}
correlation_distances.note: Optional w uses weighted means, products and norms. Constant supported rows have undefined correlation and return NaN.

angular_distances.title: Angular
angular_distances.note: Returns radians in [0,π]. Inputs must have nonzero norms; coincident directions use a zero subgradient.

canberra_distances.title: Canberra
canberra_distances.note: A joint zero coordinate contributes zero. Optional w scales the coordinate terms.

braycurtis_distances.title: Bray-Curtis
braycurtis_distances.note: Optional w scales numerator and denominator coordinates. An all-zero denominator is undefined.

haversine_distances.title: Haversine
haversine_distances.note: Each vector is latitude/longitude in radians, D=2. Returns an angle on the unit sphere; multiply by the sphere radius for lengths.

snr_distances.title: Variance-Ratio SNR Distance
snr_distances.note: Directed vector discrepancy using feature-axis variances; this is not an audio SNR score in decibels.

nan_euclidean_distances.title: NaN-Aware Euclidean
nan_euclidean_distances.note: O contains jointly observed coordinates. No shared observations returns NaN; infinities are rejected. squared=True omits the root.

lorentzian_distances.title: Lorentzian
lorentzian_distances.note: Natural logarithms soften the contribution of large coordinate differences.

clark_distances.title: Clark
clark_distances.note: Finite nonnegative coordinates. A joint zero coordinate contributes zero.

soergel_distances.title: Soergel
soergel_distances.note: Finite nonnegative coordinates. Two zero vectors return zero. Ruzicka has the same formula on this domain.

ruzicka_distances.title: Ruzicka / Continuous Jaccard
ruzicka_distances.note: Finite nonnegative coordinates, with zero for two zero vectors. Equivalent to Soergel on this domain; continuous_jaccard is an alias.

hamming_distances.title: Hamming
hamming_distances.note: Numeric or Boolean inputs; tests equality without converting numeric values to Boolean. w gives a weighted fraction.

jaccard_distances.title: Jaccard
jaccard_distances.note: Boolean contingency counts; empty union returns zero. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

dice_distances.title: Dice
dice_distances.note: Boolean contingency counts; both vectors empty gives NaN. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

yule_distances.title: Yule
yule_distances.note: Boolean contingency counts; an undefined zero/zero ratio uses zero. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

rogerstanimoto_distances.title: Rogers-Tanimoto
rogerstanimoto_distances.note: Counts agreements of both true and false coordinates. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

sokalmichener_distances.title: Sokal-Michener
sokalmichener_distances.note: The implemented convention equals Rogers-Tanimoto; retained as a familiar named entry. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

russellrao_distances.title: Russell-Rao
russellrao_distances.note: Counts only jointly true coordinates as agreement; nonempty all-false vectors have distance 1. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

sokalsneath_distances.title: Sokal-Sneath
sokalsneath_distances.note: Both vectors empty gives NaN. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

kulczynski1_distances.title: Kulczynski 1
kulczynski1_distances.note: A legacy ratio rather than a conventional distance; equal nonempty supports may give infinity. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

kulsinski_distances.title: Kulsinski
kulsinski_distances.note: Retains the legacy Kulsinski definition, distinct from Kulczynski 1. For Boolean formulas a=c11, b=c10, c=c01, d=c00 and t=a+b+c+d. Optional w replaces counts by weight sums.

hellinger_distances.title: Hellinger
hellinger_distances.note: Nonnegative positive-mass rows are normalized independently. Range [0,1]; no pseudocount.

bhattacharyya_distances.title: Bhattacharyya Distance
bhattacharyya_distances.note: Normalizes nonnegative positive-mass rows. Disjoint supports give infinity; not a triangle-inequality metric.

kl_divergences.title: Kullback-Leibler
kl_divergences.note: Normalizes nonnegative positive-mass rows. Positive p with zero q gives infinity. base changes logarithm units.

symmetric_kl_divergences.title: Symmetric KL / Jeffreys
symmetric_kl_divergences.note: The directional KL sum, without a factor of one half or a root. Normalizes each row.

jensenshannon_distances.title: Jensen-Shannon
jensenshannon_distances.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. Rooted distance; base controls logarithm units.

total_variation_distances.title: Total Variation
total_variation_distances.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. Range [0,1].

fisher_rao_distances.title: Fisher-Rao
fisher_rao_distances.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. Uses the factor-two convention, range [0,π].

renyi_divergences.title: Rényi
renyi_divergences.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. alpha>0; alpha=1 uses the KL limit. Natural logarithms.

pearson_chi2_divergences.title: Pearson Chi-Squared
pearson_chi2_divergences.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. The second operand supplies the denominator; support mismatch may give infinity.

neyman_chi2_divergences.title: Neyman Chi-Squared
neyman_chi2_divergences.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. Reverses the Pearson denominator.

triangular_discrimination_distances.title: Triangular Discrimination
triangular_discrimination_distances.note: Normalizes each nonnegative positive-mass row. No factor of one half; range [0,2]. Joint zeros contribute zero.

itakura_saito_divergences.title: Itakura-Saito
itakura_saito_divergences.note: Raw strictly positive entries, without row normalization. Scaling both operands equally preserves the divergence.

aitchison_distances.title: Aitchison
aitchison_distances.note: Strictly positive finite compositions. No pseudocount; independent row scaling preserves the result.

wasserstein_1d_distances.title: Shared-Grid 1D Wasserstein
wasserstein_1d_distances.note: Inputs are normalized histogram masses, not raw support samples. bin_positions supplies one strictly increasing shared grid; default unit-spaced bins.

linear_kernel.title: Linear Kernel
linear_kernel.note: Raw dot product; no automatic centering or normalization.

polynomial_kernel.title: Polynomial Kernel
polynomial_kernel.note: degree defaults to 3, gamma to 1/D and coef0 to 1.

sigmoid_kernel.title: Sigmoid Similarity
sigmoid_kernel.note: gamma defaults to 1/D and coef0 to 1. Not positive-semidefinite for arbitrary parameters.

rbf_kernel.title: RBF / Gaussian Kernel
rbf_kernel.note: gamma defaults to 1/D; use explicit gamma to match another kernel parameterization.

laplacian_kernel.title: Laplacian Kernel
laplacian_kernel.note: Uses Manhattan distance, with gamma=1/D by default. Distinct from Matérn nu=0.5 in multiple dimensions.

cosine_similarity.title: Cosine Similarity
cosine_similarity.note: Zero-norm cross comparisons return zero. The short cosine alias denotes similarity only inside kernel selectors.

additive_chi2_kernel.title: Additive Chi-Squared
additive_chi2_kernel.note: Nonnegative coordinates; joint zeros contribute zero. Uses the negative additive chi-squared convention.

chi2_kernel.title: Chi-Squared Kernel
chi2_kernel.note: Nonnegative coordinates; joint zeros contribute zero. gamma defaults to 1.

rational_quadratic_kernel.title: Rational Quadratic
rational_quadratic_kernel.note: Positive scalar length_scale=1 and alpha=1 by default; isotropic and unit amplitude.

matern_kernel.title: Matérn
matern_kernel.note: nu is 0.5, 1.5 (default) or 2.5. Positive scalar length_scale defaults to 1.

histogram_intersection_kernel.title: Histogram Intersection
histogram_intersection_kernel.note: Raw nonnegative masses, without normalization. Self similarity equals total mass; ties split gradients equally.

bhattacharyya_kernel.title: Bhattacharyya Coefficient
bhattacharyya_kernel.note: Normalizes nonnegative positive-mass rows. This is the coefficient; its negative logarithm is the Bhattacharyya distance.

directed_hausdorff_distances.title: Directed Hausdorff
directed_hausdorff_distances.note: Generic selectors return values. The named all-pairs function also returns source/target witness indices. Directional: no condensed mode.

hausdorff_distances.title: Hausdorff
hausdorff_distances.note: Unordered finite point sets. Different point counts and valid prefix lengths are supported.

chamfer_distances.title: Chamfer
chamfer_distances.note: rho is Euclidean distance by default, squared Euclidean with squared=True. Returns the sum of directional means.

energy_distances.title: Energy Distance
energy_distances.note: Uniform empirical masses. Includes within-cloud diagonals; squared=True returns the clamped expression without the root.

mmd_distances.title: Kernel MMD Distance
mmd_distances.formula: \operatorname{MMD}(X,Y)=\sqrt{\max\{\mathbb E k(X,X^{\prime})+\mathbb E k(Y,Y^{\prime})-2\mathbb E k(X,Y),0\}}
mmd_distances.note: Biased empirical expectations include within-cloud diagonals. squared=True omits the root. Kernel selection and scale matter; historical laplacian uses Euclidean ground while laplacian_kernel uses Manhattan ground.

mmd_statistics.title: Squared MMD Statistic
mmd_statistics.note: estimator="unbiased" is the default and requires at least two valid points on each side. estimator="biased" includes diagonals. Signed result: no clamp or root.

wasserstein_distances.title: Discrete Wasserstein
wasserstein_distances.note: Uniform masses; p=1 or 2. Exact discrete solve for at most 4096 positive-mass point pairs, with CPU solver coordination even for CUDA inputs.

sliced_wasserstein_distances.title: Sliced Wasserstein
sliced_wasserstein_distances.note: Explicit shared unit projections [D,L] are required; p=1 or 2. Handles unequal point counts by exact projected quantile integration. This is sliced, not full-dimensional Wp.

sinkhorn_divergences.title: Sinkhorn Divergence
sinkhorn_divergences.note: Cij=||xi−yj||₂^p, p=1 or 2. Fixed-budget log-domain updates, regularization=0.1 and max_iter=100. Full KL-regularized objective, not transport-only cost. Finite-budget results may be negative; no root.

gaussian_wasserstein_distances.title: Gaussian Wasserstein / Bures
gaussian_wasserstein_distances.note: Means and finite symmetric positive-semidefinite covariances. Default returns W2; squared=True returns the expression shown. Singular covariance boundaries use a finite derivative continuation.

log_euclidean_distances.title: Log-Euclidean
log_euclidean_distances.note: Symmetric positive-definite matrices; principal matrix logarithm. squared=True returns the squared Frobenius distance.

affine_invariant_distances.title: Affine-Invariant Riemannian
affine_invariant_distances.note: Symmetric positive-definite matrices. squared=True returns the squared distance. No jitter or eigenvalue clipping.

stein_distances.title: Stein / Jensen-Bregman LogDet
stein_distances.note: Symmetric positive-definite matrices. squared=True returns the divergence inside the root, not its square.

gaussian_mixture_overlap_kernel.title: Gaussian-Mixture Overlap
gaussian_mixture_overlap_kernel.note: Normalized nonnegative weights and SPD covariances. Exact density overlap, without learned models.

gaussian_mixture_l2_distances.title: Gaussian-Mixture L2
gaussian_mixture_l2_distances.note: Uses Gaussian density overlap K and SPD covariances. squared=True omits the root; negative roundoff residuals are clamped to zero.

gaussian_mixture_cauchy_schwarz_divergen.title: Gaussian-Mixture Cauchy-Schwarz
gaussian_mixture_cauchy_schwarz_divergen.note: Uses Gaussian density overlap K and SPD covariances. Natural logarithm, no factor of two; stable log-overlap evaluation.

gaussian_mixture_wasserstein_distances.title: Gaussian-Mixture Wasserstein
gaussian_mixture_wasserstein_distances.note: PSD covariances. Restricts transport to Gaussian component couplings: not exact W2 between full mixture densities. At most 4096 positive-mass component pairs; CPU-controlled solve. squared=True omits the root.

gaussian_mixture_entropic_transport_cost.title: Gaussian-Mixture Entropic Transport
gaussian_mixture_entropic_transport_cost.note: PSD covariances; finite-iteration estimate of the full regularized objective. regularization=0.1, max_iter=100. Includes entropy; self costs need not vanish.

gaussian_mixture_sinkhorn_divergences.title: Gaussian-Mixture Sinkhorn
gaussian_mixture_sinkhorn_divergences.note: Gaussian component W2² ground costs and PSD covariances. Fixed-budget regularized updates; no root or nonnegative clamp. Finite-budget estimates may be negative.

psnr_scores.title: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio
psnr_scores.note: Aligned whole images; data_range R is required. Returns dB. Identical images give +infinity with a chosen zero derivative.

ssim_scores.title: Structural Similarity / SSIM
ssim_scores.note: Aligned images; data_range required, C1=(k1 R)² and C2=(k2 R)². Gaussian-weighted population moments with valid windows; negative scores retained.

multiscale_ssim_scores.title: Multiscale SSIM
multiscale_ssim_scores.note: SSIM luminance l and contrast/structure cs terms across average-pooled scales. data_range required. Weights are not renormalized; nonpositive factors contribute zero. Match padding/pooling conventions when comparing libraries.

si_sdr_scores.title: Scale-Invariant SDR
si_sdr_scores.note: First operand is estimate e, second reference r. Per-channel dB scores are averaged. zero_mean=True and energy_floor=1e-8 by default. Zero-reference projection is zero.

signal_snr_scores.title: Signal SNR
signal_snr_scores.note: First operand is estimate e, second reference r. zero_mean=False; energy_floor=1e-8. This audio dB score differs from vector snr_distances.

log_spectral_distances.title: Log-Spectral Distance
log_spectral_distances.note: A/B are aligned STFT magnitudes. Natural logs; log_floor=1e-7. No phase or mel weighting. Different waveforms can share magnitudes.

spectral_convergence_distances.title: Spectral Convergence
spectral_convergence_distances.note: STFT magnitude Frobenius norms span channels/frequencies/frames. norm_floor=1e-7; reference normalization makes this directional.

multiresolution_stft_distances.title: Multi-Resolution STFT
multiresolution_stft_distances.note: Arithmetic mean across explicit FFT/hop/window resolution triples. Equal weight for convergence and log-magnitude terms. No sample-rate conversion or phase alignment.

dtw_distances.title: Dynamic Time Warping
dtw_distances.note: Squared-Euclidean local costs; squared=True returns the minimum path sum. Optional integer window imposes |i−j|≤window. Infeasible pairs give infinity.

soft_dtw_divergences.title: Debiased Soft-DTW
soft_dtw_divergences.note: Sγ uses the DTW recurrence with softmin. Positive gamma is required. Signed, unrooted and unclamped; no general triangle-inequality guarantee.

levenshtein_distances.title: Levenshtein
levenshtein_distances.note: Integer token IDs, unit insertion/deletion/substitution costs. Returns int64; valid prefix lengths may be zero. Tokens are labels, not numeric features.

indel_distances.title: Insertion/Deletion
indel_distances.note: Integer tokens. Insertion/deletion cost one, substitution cost two. No normalization by length; int64 output.
